name: Drake Master
body:
You and your drake are as one.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Friend, character level 13th.

Benefit(s): Your legendary drake companion may possess up to 15 hit dice.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
